issues.description: Constructor signature mismatch for Bitmap24: the template header declares Bitmap24(long i_width, long i_height) while the template implementation defines Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height). This mismatch will cause build/link errors and confuse students about the correct constructor signature. The solution repository uses the int signature, indicating the header in the template is incorrect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor declaration in the template header match the implementation and the solution. Change the declaration in template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp to: Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height); (or change the implementation to use long parameters, but aligning the header to int is the minimal fix consistent with the solution).
